text: ぬすんだ　やつは　かくじつに　この　あたりに　きたんだが…　みうしなって　しまった！

structure.jp: かくじつに　この　あたりに　きたんだが…
みうしなって　しまった！

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.span: みうしなって　しまった
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happened completely, often to your regret. みうしなって しまった = 'I went and lost sight of him'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a person or thing describes it, like 'who' in English. ぬすんだ やつ = 'the guy who stole it'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ, the spoken form of のだ, is added when explaining how things are. With が after it, it sets up a 'but'. きたんだが = 'he did come, but'.
